why: Hand-verified links for entity strings that the free-text gazetteer must refuse as ambiguous, too short, or outside its derived awarder-name rules. These entries are consulted only after the analysis model has classified the string into the matching entity bucket.
rules: Every link names a route that the main site actually serves and carries review evidence.
requires_any is a context gate over the complete article or story entity set; without one of those entities the override does not apply.
Refused entries document institutions visible in news stories for which electionsbg.com has no corresponding entity page.
